The Cottages

Pick your shoreline.

Two cottages sit lakefront, right next to each other, and share a private dock and fire pit. The third is a lakeview cottage across the way — not on the water, but it's the only one that's pet friendly.

The Lakefront Cottage

Sleeps 4·2 Bed / 1 Bath·Lakefront

Right on Cain's Mill Lake with a big lakefront deck, a free canoe, and a floating dock. Shares its private dock and fire pit with the Chalet next door. ★5.0 (29 reviews)

The Lakefront Chalet

3 Bed / 1 Bath·Lakefront·Pedal Boat

The largest of the three, with a wrap-around deck on Cain's Mill Lake and its own pedal boat. Shares the private dock and fire pit with the Cottage next door. ★4.97 (119 reviews)

Vila do Sol

Sleeps 4·2 Bed / 1 Bath·Pet Friendly

A newly renovated, sunny-yellow lakeview cottage with a fully fenced yard and deck — the only one of the three that welcomes pets. It's not lakefront and doesn't share the dock or fire pit, but the public beach is a short walk diagonally across the street. ★5.0 (5 reviews)

A Note From Your Host

Hosted directly, not managed remotely.

These cottages have been in the family for years, and after a career teaching at Rowan University, looking after them is where most of my time goes now. I'm not a property management company — when you book, you're renting from the person who mows the lawn and fixes the dock ladder.

That means real answers to your questions before you arrive, and someone who actually knows the lake to point you toward the best sunset spot, the quietest hour on the water, and the diner worth the drive.

— Your host, Lakefront Vacation 4U
